intro.title: Tulip Marbling Begins
intro.text: Every cell that bursts gets a paint stain: first ×2, doubling each time in the same cell, up to ×256. Stains stay for the whole feature and slide along with the comb; a cluster that passes over them has its pay multiplied by the sum of the stains. 3 Golden Combs give +4 spins.

how.title: How to play
how.s1: Choose your bet. The − and + buttons change the bet by one step; tapping the bet amount opens every step. “{max}” picks the highest step your balance covers.
how.s2: Spin. Press the ink button or use the space bar. The round cost ({multiple} times the bet when Chance ×2 is on) is taken from your balance once.
how.s3: Build clusters. In the 7 × 7 water tray, 5 or more adjacent drops of the same colour, horizontally or vertically, pay; the larger the cluster, the higher the pay tier.
how.s4: Chain. Winning clusters dissolve into the water, the ones above fall and new drops fill the gaps; this continues until no cluster is left.
how.s5: Comb. When the chain ends — even with no win — the Golden Comb sweeps the water: each row slides right or left by its own amount and new clusters may form. At most {passes} comb passes per spin.
how.s6: Result. The whole round is decided by the engine before the spin starts; the animation only plays that result back. The Spin button stays locked until the round (every tumble, comb pass and free spin) has finished; use the {quick}/{turbo} setting to speed things up. Speed settings, tapping the celebration counter, a hidden tab or leaving the page never change the payout; the round always closes once, with the engine’s payout.
how.note: DEMO credit has no value; it does not earn SOL, tokens or rewards. The game runs in the browser with local randomness; there is no VRF proof.

pay.title: Paytable
pay.lead: 5 or more adjacent drops of the same colour, horizontally or vertically, form a cluster. The large figure is the gross DEMO amount at a bet of {bet}; the multiplier below it is a multiple of the bet. Every cluster on the same grid pays separately.
pay.fullCaption: Pay by colour and cluster size, as a multiple of the bet
pay.scatterText: If the final grid of the base spin holds 3 or more Golden Combs, they pay and unlock {spins} free spins (Tulip Marbling). Combs do not dissolve; they only fall and slide with the comb.
pay.dropText: It does not join a cluster itself; where it lands it spreads its ink: it picks the most frequent colour among its 4 neighbours and paints its neighbours and itself that colour. Details are on the “{features}” page.
pay.maxText: At this bet that is {amount}. If the round total reaches this cap the round ends immediately; remaining free spins are not played.

features.title: Features
features.combText: When each tumble chain ends, the comb sweeps the board once: row r slides round(A · sin(φ + r · k)) columns cyclically (what leaves on the right enters on the left). A is 1, 2 or 3 on each pass ({weights}); φ and k are drawn again on every pass. If the shift forms a new cluster the chain continues; if not, the spin ends. At most {passes} passes per spin. Symbols only change places; none is added or removed.
features.combExample: Example: A = 2, φ = 0, k = 8·2π/64 → row shifts {shifts}.
features.combExampleAria: Example comb pass, shift per row
features.dropText: The moment it lands (on the deal or on a refill) it spreads its ink: it counts the colours of its 4 neighbours, picks the most frequent one (a tie is broken at random; with no coloured neighbour a random colour is used), paints its coloured neighbours that colour and becomes that colour itself. Golden Combs are not painted.
features.freeText: 3+ Golden Combs unlock {trigger} free spins. In free spins every cell that bursts gets a paint stain multiplier: ×2 the first time, doubling each time in the same cell, up to ×{stainMax}. Stains stay for the whole feature; tumbles do not move them, but the comb pass sweeps the stains with the same shift as the symbols. When a cluster passes over stained cells, its pay is multiplied by the sum of the stains under it (pay first, then the new stain). In free spins 3+ combs add {retrigger} spins; a single round plays at most {max} spins. The Soot Drop does not spread in free spins (only a Master Drop with no coloured neighbour can pick that colour at random).
features.cumText: The win meter never resets during a round: clusters, comb wins, the scatter pay and all free spins add up in the same total. A free-spin round always ends with the “{screen}” screen.
features.tiersText: When the round total is 10× your base bet or more, the celebration screen opens and the counter climbs through the tiers: {big} ≥10×, {mega} ≥25×, {super} ≥50×, {epic} ≥100×; a round that reaches the cap ends with {max}. Stain multipliers of ×10 and above are announced in large type above the grid with their own sound. Tapping the screen jumps the counter to the result; it never changes the payout.
features.anteText: While on, every spin costs {multiple} times your bet and Golden Combs are more likely in the base game: the free-spin chance is roughly double ({ante} / {standard}). Wins are still paid on the base bet. The bonus can’t be bought while it is on.
features.buyText: For 100 times your bet the round starts with at least 3 Golden Combs; {spins} free spins are guaranteed. The purchase is made through a confirmation window, runs at a separate RTP ({rtp}) and can’t be used with autoplay.

rtp.title: RTP
rtp.heading: Theoretical return (RTP)
rtp.caption: Theoretical return per mode
rtp.method: A separate simulation of {millions} million rounds for each mode (engine ebru-ink-1). RTP is calculated against the amount paid. Hit frequency (base spin): standard {hit}, Chance ×2 {hitAnte}. Volatility (standard deviation in cost units): standard {sdStandard}, buy {sdBuy}.
rtp.note: The simulation is an estimate and is uncertified; because of the heavy tail the confidence interval may be optimistic. Results in a short session can differ greatly from the RTP. DEMO credit has no value.

limits.title: Bet and win limits
limits.maxValue: {n} times the bet · {amount} at this bet
limits.p1: A round that reaches the max win ends immediately; remaining free spins are not played. The payout is always calculated on the base bet, with fractions of a cent rounded down.
limits.p2: Steps and modes your balance can’t cover can’t be selected. A round is a single reservation and a single payout; only one round is played at a time.

keys.title: Keys
keys.heading: Keyboard
keys.spaceText: Starts the spin ({settings} → “{option}”). During a round it doesn’t skip the spin; it only speeds up the free-spin screens and the celebration counter.
keys.escText: Closes the open window (except the session reminder).
keys.tabText: Moves between controls; focus is always visible.
keys.arrowsText: Switches pages in this info window; changes the option in setting choices.
keys.note: The screen reader announces every step (“{example}”, comb passes, the round result); the grid is read as a 7×7 table and stained cells are read with their multiplier. Symbols are told apart by shape as well as colour (tulip, carnation, hatip flower, leaf, peacock eye, daisy, rose, pebble). The reduced-motion preference shortens the comb to a brief slide and turns off particles and shaking.

fault.title: Fault clause
fault.p1: A fault voids all affected games and payouts. In case of a software, browser or device fault the round record is authoritative; an amount that appears on screen but does not match the engine record is not valid.
fault.p2: This game is played with DEMO credit only. DEMO has no value and cannot be converted to money or tokens; in case of a fault the DEMO balance and session history may be corrected or reset.
fault.p3: Because the result is decided before the spin, an animation that is cut short, a hidden tab or leaving the page does not change the result; the round still closes once with the engine’s payout.
